author: /root/r36_scientific_contract_preparation
scope: Same-task acquisition continuity only. Original frozen contract, science, IDs, accuracy and acceptance unchanged. No science producer executed by this preparer.
approved_source_assumptions: Use the exact official product-action URL and product ID in the main contract. A successful HTTP200 full response is a new actual acquisition attempt, not a new task or allowance.

No independently published provider checksum is currently available. Record that provenance limit; actual downloaded SHA256, official product identity, expected total bytes and FITS/header checks are sufficient here. Do not invent upstream byte identity.

Range was ignored by the observed server. The proposed resume method therefore starts a new full GET, byte-compares its prefix with the preserved partial file, and appends only after the entire preserved prefix matches. It does not claim network-byte savings.

A completed assembly consists byte-for-byte of that one fresh response: its prefix has been verified against retained bytes, and its suffix comes from the same response. This is valid exact assembly without a provider hash.
required_controls: Use a new helper source file; never modify executing fetch source. Controller and worker own the cooperative checkpoint. Before replacement, prove previous writer has stopped/quiesced, record PID/start/status, preserved partial path/length/SHA256 and elapsed/downloaded counters; only one writer per partial file.

New helper opens the retained prefix read-only for comparison. It must not truncate or overwrite existing bytes. Check exact URL/product, HTTP200, compatible FITS content and payload header before accepting append mode.

Compare the entire old prefix byte-for-byte before appending any new suffix. A prefix mismatch, response shorter than prefix, wrong product, unexpected content or concurrent file-size change stops with original partial unchanged and records evidence. Do not silently restart/delete or accept an offset-only match.

Once prefix matches, append only subsequent bytes of the same response. On another interruption, preserve the longer partial with fresh size/hash and cumulative receipt; the next attempt again compares its full retained prefix.

Completion requires clean response termination, exact catalog size, full assembled-file SHA256 and FITS/header/schema verification. Extra or missing bytes remain incomplete/error. Promote to final path atomically only after these checks.

Test helper mechanics with small local prefix-match, mismatch, truncation, interrupted suffix and sole-writer fixtures. These are transport tests, not additional science draws. A different Astra agent independently reviews helper and actual receipts.
resource_and_controller_policy: No new invocation/walltime/RAM/total-byte cap or reset. Parent supplies actual limits. Count every attempt, repeated prefix network bytes, walltime and failures cumulatively under the same packet.
Maintain owner-required at least2GiB free disk reserve. Pause acquisition cooperatively before losing this reserve; preserve validated partial and receipts. Do not remove unrelated data.

Controller may checkpoint this acquisition, dispatch independent READY work, and later resume this exact packet/helper state. This is resumable acquisition, not permanent scientific HOLD, cancellation or qualified product.
Unknown historical PID/start observations stay UNKNOWN. Existing successful exit0 producer receipts remain preserved and are not manufactured into historical process observation.
